title: Introduce declarative retry profiles and generator-based stream facade; coordinate multi-SDK ergonomics bump
author: Maya Kapoor
release_notes: Added declarative retry profile API and a generator-based stream facade to simplify streaming ergonomics. Coordinated minor version bumps for Python/Go companion SDKs. No breaking changes to existing call signatures; opt-in features behind flags.
description:
Motivation: Developers repeatedly ask for a simple, declarative way to express retry semantics (backoff, idempotency predicates, circuit-breaker thresholds) that can be shared across SDKs and surfaced in the Console. At the same time, our streaming APIs are still awkward for generator-based consumers; this PR introduces a small ergonomic wrapper that exposes streams as async generators while preserving the existing pull/push semantics. This change unifies patterns we ship across TS/Python/Go and reduces boilerplate in app code.

What this PR includes: - A new declarative RetryProfile DSL (RetryProfile.fromSpec(spec)) that maps to runtime presets used by our agent/runtime. Profiles support: initial_delay_ms, max_delay_ms, multiplier, max_attempts, retryable_codes, idempotency_hint, and circuit_breaker (failure_threshold, recovery_ms). - An implementation of the retry engine used by the TS SDK that compiles the declarative profile into an execution plan (non-blocking, uses backoff timers tied to the SDK event loop). - A generator-based StreamFacade (createStreamGenerator) that yields chunk objects and handles resume/reauth transparently. The facade supports pause/resume, graceful drain, and an opt-in memory cap. - Cross-SDK compatibility notes and a small coordination shim used by the central session/credential orchestrator (this PR adds TypeScript types and a minimal contract used during coordinated release). - Tests for policy parsing, backoff timing behavior (fast simulated timers), stream resume semantics, and telemetry hooks for backoff/counts. - Docs: inline typed comments + a new short guide in docs/streams/retry-profiles.md (examples) and an updated CHANGELOG entry.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-4312) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Cross-SDK coordination note updated - [x] Docs + changelog - [x] Version bump token (v3.7.0 -> v3.8.0)

Review conversation (high level): - Anika Rao (reviewer): "Overall shape looks good. Two main asks: make RetryProfile JSON schema backwards compatible and ensure the generator facade exposes a clear cancel signal. Please add more unit tests around intermittent auth failures and edge-case timeouts." - Author (Maya): "Addressed both: parser now accepts legacy short-form (string presets) and maps to full spec; generator facade exposes cancel() via the returned controller. Added tests for intermittent auth and mocked timeouts." - James Lin: "Can you confirm that telemetry tags include profile name and applied_attempts to surface in Console?" - Maya: "Yes, telemetry/retryCounters.ts emits profile_name and attempt_count; added an integration test asserting tags." - Sven Müller: "Small nit: the memory_cap option uses bytes but docs mention 'tokens' — corrected docs." - Anika: "Approve after green CI."

CI summary: - build: passed - lint: passed (fixed a handful of TSlint complaints) - unit tests: passed - integration tests: flaky stream-resume.test initially failed (race in fake timer); reran on CI and passed - e2e (smoke): passed

Merge: Squash merge performed after final approval. Merge method: squash and merge. Release note: v3.8.0; coordinated releases for Python v2.11.0 and Go v1.5.3 were created in the companion repos (see Linear ENG-4390).
